hero.title: Practical open-source tools & indie builds, built to stay yours.
hero.subtitle: We design open hardware, zero-bloat desktop utilities, and original indie games. Everything ships without mandatory accounts, cloud subscriptions, or telemetry trackers.

about.title: Simple ideas, shared openly.
paragraphs: Most of what we build starts because we needed a tool ourselves and could only find over-engineered commercial options tied to cloud accounts or heavy background software.
From programmable macro pads and split-perimeter room security hardware to original games like Sluníčka and Protikód, we publish transparent builds verified with SHA-256 checksums on ReleaseHub.

principles.title: Runs on its own
principles.description: Tools should keep working even when the internet is down. We design for local networks and onboard memory first.

principles.title: Zero background bloat
principles.description: We avoid heavy installers and always-on desktop daemons when onboard EEPROM or static specs can do the job.

principles.title: Verified sovereign releases
principles.description: Game builds, firmware OTA binaries, and AltStore packages ship with transparent SHA-256 digests via releases.eggmanstudios.me.
